applicabilityBasis.summary: The issuer describes a transferable fiat-referenced payment token with face-value redemption, rather than a bank deposit or fund share. U.S. offer/sale scope and token-specific GENIUS authorization have not been established.

genius.notes: The review maps the exact token to its foreign issuer and does not establish U.S. distribution, official GENIUS approval/application or a registered foreign-issuer exception. Foreign licensing and reserve disclosures are not substituted for U.S. authorization. A complete U.S. negative-evidence census was not performed; authorization is unknown, not no-public-authorization-found.
